name: What legal protections are in place for buyers of new construction condos in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What legal protections are in place for buyers of new construction condos in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Florida Statute Chapter 718, known as the Condominium Act, governs new construction condominiums, providing buyers with various protections. These include mandatory disclosure documents, the right to rescind a purchase contract within a specific timeframe (often 15 days from receiving all documents), and requirements for escrowing deposits. It's crucial preparation to review all disclosure materials and contracts with a real estate professional or attorney to understand your rights and obligations fully before committing to a purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Florida's Condominium Act (Chapter 718) protects new condo buyers with mandatory disclosures and rescission rights. Reviewing all documents with a professional is crucial preparation.
